_doc: Each user workflow -> the LIVE tests (real processes, run by a mandatory scripts/verify.sh stage) that cover it. Checked by scripts/check_live_coverage.py: statically early in the gate (map complete, files exist, live specs are run by a stage), and after the reality stages with --junit (every live pytest node id PASSED in this run). `optional` = opt-in stages only (RUN_DOCKER_TESTS, RUN_JOURNEY_TESTS, RUN_CLAUDE_TESTS). `gap` = an honest statement that no mandatory live test exists. Definition of done (docs/TESTING_REALITY.md): a feature is not done until a committed live scenario for its workflow runs in the gate.

O1.title: operator: drift chart and the Session tab (built-in agent session, live graph, alerts in the UI)

O2.title: operator: inbox approve / deny of a held proxy call

O3.title: operator: deny with a note, the agent adapts
O3.note: the mandatory live test proves the note reaches the agent and the log, and that the adapted call (made by a scripted agent) lands after approval; a REAL agent adapting (the optional Claude Code test) is observed and printed, not asserted: that test asserts only that the denied file never landed and that every file that did land was approved

O4.title: operator: alerts on the card, and the note-aware label on what the operator suggested

O5.title: operator: turn a decision into a standing rule (two-step confirm) that applies to a new session

O6.title: operator: several operators deciding concurrently (races, roles, who decided)

D1.title: developer: put the proxy in front of any stdio MCP server

D2.title: developer: auto_approve flag and the boundary chips / credentials warning

D3.title: developer: Landlock + network-namespace sandbox for a downstream

D4.title: developer: the built-in agent loop against a model provider
D4.note: the mandatory stages use a SCRIPTED provider over real HTTP (hostile and fake LLM servers); a REAL provider runs only in the opt-in journey j10 (needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY)

A1.title: admin: write a policy, and policy-test it against the logged human decisions

A3.title: admin: identity mode (identity file, roles, tenants, escalation)

L2.title: auditor: eventlog_cli replay of a logged session

L3.title: auditor: rotate the log and verify --previous (tampered and missing archives detected)

P1.title: platform: the Docker image and compose stack
P1.gap: needs a Docker daemon and ~6 minutes: real containers run only in the opt-in RUN_DOCKER_TESTS=1 stage (the static Dockerfile/compose tests in the default suite are not live)
